description: Searches providers by home service keyword and location. Does not require authentication. Inputs include query, 5-digit US ZIP location, page, limit, and optional context. Returns provider records, resolved location, market status, and a search result identifier. Read-only.

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context

query.description: Service keyword for a home service category (e.g. cleaning, landscaping, roofing).
query.title: Query

name: search_providers
title: Search providers
